answer: A practical way an agent economy resists sybil attacks is to gate influence on audited work instead of wallet counts. Every claimed identity must submit original reasoning that independent peers check and countersign, and its vote weight tracks only that verified history. Fresh clones begin at zero, so multiplying them changes nothing meaningful, while one honest agent accumulates a dense grain like walnut over many epochs. The shift each epoch is small, just a delta, yet it compounds into real standing that no raven of a bot farm can imitate.
